metadata.description: Agent skills from brokenrobot.xyz — focused plugins, installable individually.

plugins.name: committing-conventionally
plugins.description: Authors Conventional-Commits commits and enforces them with a deny-hook, resolving the commit vocabulary from the host project's .brokenrobot-xyz/commits.json with vanilla Conventional Commits defaults.

plugins.name: writing-simplified-technical-english
plugins.description: Revises agent-facing prose — skills, agent definitions, specs, and technical docs — so an agent cannot read a sentence two ways, applying twelve conventions adapted from ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English.

plugins.name: prompt-quality-criteria
plugins.description: Supplies criteria groups B–G for grading a Markdown prompt that steers Claude — model-specific prompting, general prompting, hallucination guards, output consistency, injection defenses, and prompt-leak defenses. Returns the criteria; the caller scores against them.

plugins.name: reviewing-claude-skills
plugins.description: Reviews a Claude Code skill — its SKILL.md, evals, and referenced files — in two passes: structure first, stopping at a structural verdict when the workflow's shape fails; otherwise a full sweep against skill-authoring and prompting best practices plus the host project's conventions, producing a severity-ranked gap analysis that ends in a computed verdict — acceptable, or not yet — honoring the skill's recorded waivers, with optional fixes. Each pass runs in a plugin subagent to keep the main conversation lean.

plugins.name: frontend-toolkit
plugins.description: A suite of frontend skills, starting with updating-dependencies: detects and categorizes outdated npm packages, researches the bumps the user selects with a dedicated subagent, and applies only the bumps the user approves — keeping each entry's existing version prefix and attributing new audit advisories to the update. Never commits.

plugins.name: improving-claude-skills
plugins.description: Autonomously improves a Claude Code skill in a review→fix→re-review loop: each round invokes the reviewing-claude-skills review non-interactively, applies every actionable finding — High and structural findings included — without per-fix approval, commits the round, and re-reviews, until the findings converge, plateau, or hit the round cap. Asks one question only: confirming the intent brief at kickoff.

plugins.name: reviewing-claude-subagents
plugins.description: Reviews a Claude Code subagent definition — its frontmatter, body, declared tools, and routing siblings — against subagent-authoring and prompting best practices plus the host project's conventions, producing a severity-ranked gap analysis with optional fixes.
